 Phil Wickham Set to Perform for Fox News Christmas Tree Lighting On Friday 
 GMA News
 Nov 17, 2026, 10:53:39 AM
 Three-time GRAMMY®-nominated worship artist and songwriter Phil Wickham is ushering in the holiday season with the release of his Christmas album, Hallelujah! It's Christmas Again!, available this Friday, November 20. Expanding on his 2024 release, the collection features four new songs and three live recordings, bringing fresh music to a project that celebrates the hope and joy of Christ's birth.
 To celebrate the release, Wickham will perform live at FOX News' 7th Annual All-American Christmas Tree Lighting on Friday, November 20 at 5 pm Eastern.
 Taking place on FOX Square outside the network's New York City headquarters, the annual event will feature Wickham performing multiple songs, including "Peace On Earth" from his Christmas album, which is releasing the same day.
 With Hallelujah! It's Christmas Again! , Wickham continues to create music that invites listeners to celebrate the season through worship, blending beloved holiday classics with original songs that can become part of families' Christmas traditions. Ahead of the album's release, Wickham released " Peace On Earth ," a collaboration with Christian and Gospel music icon CeCe Winans. Last week, he released " O Holy Night (Adoration) ."
 The new release follows a milestone season for Wickham, who recently celebrated three wins at the 2026 GMA Dove Awards, including Artist of the Year and Worship Album of the Year . He also recently concluded his Song of the Saints Tour, which brought nights of worship to 40 arenas nationwide. Wickham’s Christmas music and annual Hallelujah! It’s Christmas Southern California Tour has become a cherished holiday tradition for longtime fans and new listeners alike, bringing people together to celebrate the joy and hope of the Christmas season.
